title: Relative flatness comparison for cartesian models
statement: For two cartesian squares P and Q of the same morphisms f:X -> S and g:T -> S [def-pc-fibre-product], and any module M on X [def-pc-module-pullback], the tensor pullback of M to P is flat over T if and only if its tensor pullback to Q is flat over T [def-pc-scheme-module-flat-over].

proof.text: The two cartesian squares give a unique isomorphism e:P -> Q compatible with both projections. Tensor-pullback composition identifies a^*M with e^*((a')^*M).

Transport every affine source open through e. Sections and the action of Gamma(T,V) are identified by the structure-sheaf naturality equations. Module.Flat.equiv_iff proves invariance of each affine-pair flatness test; e inverse proves the reverse implication. Empty opens have zero sections.
